title: The Early Knot Primer
summary: A primer for the rare early-awakened soul that spins its first fine thread of binding force and learns to tie it off.

title: A First Reading of the Soul Tether
summary: A first reading for the newly formed soul on casting a tether from itself to another soul and feeling it draw taut.

title: Primer of the Drawn Cord
summary: A primer on drawing a cord of soul force across the gap to an opponent and pulling it snug on the opponent's technique.

title: The Plain Fetter Course
summary: A course on the plainest fetter of the soul that holds one limb of an opponent's intent for the space of a breath.

title: Notes on the Slack Noose
summary: Short notes on a noose laid slack round an opponent's soul so that it cinches only when the opponent pulls against it.

title: The Clinging Thread Lessons
summary: Lessons on a thread that clings to a soul once laid and follows it wherever the soul runs.
